Which migration strategy should I use for 0023?

❯ 1. Down-migrate 0022 first
     Roll 0022 back on every environment, then apply a single combined
     migration. Cleanest history, but needs a deploy window.

  3. Skip 0023 for now
     Ship without the new index and revisit after the release.
